questions.context: En Sogamoso, Valentina visita cada domingo a la mamá de su mamá, que le prepara changua.

options.feedback: Incorrect. An "aunt" is the sister of your mom or dad, not the mother of your mom.
Incorrect. A "cousin" is the child of your aunt or uncle, so a cousin is about your age, not your mom's mother.
Correct. "Grandmother" is the mother of your mom or of your dad.
Incorrect. An "uncle" is a man, the brother of your mom or dad, and the question asks about a mother.

questions.explanation: La mamá de tu mamá es tu abuela, y en inglés abuela se dice "grandmother". También la mamá de tu papá es tu "grandmother". La forma cariñosa es "grandma".

questions.context: El abuelo de Simón tiene una finca cafetera en Chinchiná y le enseña a recoger café.

options.feedback: Incorrect. "Grandmother" is grandma, a woman, and "grandpa" is a man.
Correct. "Grandfather" is the full word for grandpa, the father of your mom or dad.
Incorrect. A "cousin" is the child of your aunt or uncle, a person from your own generation.
Incorrect. An "aunt" is a woman, the sister of one of your parents, so she is not your grandpa.

questions.explanation: "Grandpa" es la forma corta y cariñosa de "grandfather", que significa abuelo. El abuelo es el papá de tu mamá o de tu papá. Las palabras con "grand-" nombran a los abuelos.

questions.statement: Complete: "My mom has a sister. Her name is Paula. Paula is my ______."
questions.context: La mamá de Isabela, en Girardot, tiene una hermana llamada Paula que vive en Bogotá.

options.feedback: Correct. The sister of your mom is your "aunt", and Paula is a woman.
Incorrect. An "uncle" is a man, but Paula is a woman, the sister of the mom.
Incorrect. A "grandmother" is the mother of your mom, not her sister.
Incorrect. A "cousin" is the child of your aunt, and Paula is the aunt herself.

questions.explanation: La hermana de tu mamá (o de tu papá) es tu tía. En inglés tía se dice "aunt". Paula es mujer y es hermana de la mamá, por eso "Paula is my aunt".
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Complete: "My dad has a brother. His name is Felipe. Felipe is my ______."
questions.context: El papá de Miguel, en Cúcuta, tiene un hermano llamado Felipe que trabaja como conductor de bus.

options.feedback: Incorrect. An "aunt" is a woman, and Felipe is a man ("His name").
Incorrect. A "grandfather" is the father of your dad, not his brother.
Correct. The brother of your dad is your "uncle", and Felipe is a man.
Incorrect. A "cousin" is the child of your uncle, so Felipe's children would be cousins, not Felipe.

questions.explanation: El hermano de tu papá (o de tu mamá) es tu tío, que en inglés se dice "uncle". La palabra "His" indica que Felipe es hombre. Por eso decimos "Felipe is my uncle".
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
Read: "My uncle Felipe has a son. His name is Martin."
Martin is my ______.
questions.context: Miguel juega fútbol en Cúcuta con Martin, el hijo de su tío Felipe.

options.feedback: Incorrect. A "brother" has your same parents, but Martin is the son of your uncle.
Incorrect. The uncle in the text is Felipe; Martin is his child.
Incorrect. A "grandfather" is older than your parents, and Martin is a child of your uncle.
Correct. The son or daughter of your uncle or aunt is your "cousin".

questions.explanation: Los hijos de tus tíos son tus primos. En inglés primo y prima se dicen igual: "cousin". Como Martin es hijo del tío Felipe, Martin es "my cousin".
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
Read: "Carlos and Ines are the parents of my mom and of my aunt Paula."
Who are Carlos and Ines?
questions.context: Isabela dibuja su árbol genealógico en una cartelera para la feria de la familia de su colegio en Girardot.

options.feedback: Correct. The parents of your mom are your "grandparents": your grandfather and grandmother.
Incorrect. Cousins are the children of your aunt or uncle, but Carlos and Ines are the parents of your mom.
Incorrect. Uncles are brothers of your parents, and Carlos and Ines are one generation older than your mom.
Incorrect. Your parents are your mom and dad; Carlos and Ines are the mom's own parents.

questions.explanation: En el árbol genealógico, los papás de tu mamá están un nivel arriba de ella. Ellos son tus abuelos: "grandparents" (grandfather + grandmother). También son los papás de la tía Paula, porque ella es hermana de tu mamá.

questions.statement:
Read: "Sofia lives in Leticia with her grandmother Elena. Her aunt Marta and her cousin Pablo visit on Sundays. Pablo is Marta's son."
Which sentence is true?
questions.context: Sofia vive en Leticia, en el Amazonas, y los domingos recibe visitas de su familia.

options.feedback: Incorrect. The text says "her grandmother Elena", so Elena is the grandmother, and the aunt is Marta.
Correct. The text says "Pablo is Marta's son", so Marta is the mother of Pablo.
Incorrect. The text calls Pablo "her cousin", because he is the son of her aunt.
Incorrect. The text says Marta and Pablo visit "on Sundays", not on Mondays.

questions.explanation: Hay que leer con cuidado cada relación. Elena es la abuela ("grandmother"), Marta es la tía ("aunt") y Pablo es el primo ("cousin"). Como "Pablo is Marta's son" (Pablo es hijo de Marta), Marta es la mamá de Pablo.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.context: En una clase de inglés en Sincelejo, los niños revisan definiciones de familiares para su árbol genealógico.

options.text: My aunt is my father's brother.
options.feedback: Incorrect. The brother of your father is your uncle; an aunt is a woman, a sister of your parents.

options.text: My uncle is my mother's sister.
options.feedback: Incorrect. An uncle is a man, so he is the brother of your mother, not her sister.

options.text: My grandfather is my cousin's son.
options.feedback: Incorrect. A grandfather is the father of your parents, two generations older, not a child of your cousin.

options.text: My cousin is my uncle's daughter.
options.feedback: Correct. The daughter of your uncle is your cousin, so this definition matches the family tree.

questions.explanation: Recordemos: "aunt" (tía) es mujer y "uncle" (tío) es hombre; ambos son hermanos de tus papás. Los hijos e hijas de tus tíos son tus primos, "cousins". Por eso "My cousin is my uncle's daughter" es la única oración correcta.
questions.subject: ingles
